messages:
samir: Heads-up: onboarding quickpack for customer Caspian LoRA merge shows a new money-format regression after int4 quant — negative amounts in parentheses are getting converted to a trailing minus which breaks downstream accounting rules. Minimal repro below.

alexa: Oof. Parentheses -> trailing minus is definitely bad for ledgers. Which quant pipeline + tokenizer?

samir: AWQ-4bit, tokenizer v16. FP16 baseline is correct. Quickpack summary: 130 tests, 2 failures, both around negative amounts.

```
input: "Adjustment: ($1,234.56)"
expected: "($1,234.56)"
int4-output: "1,234.56-"
fp16-output: "($1,234.56)"
```

priya: That's weird — could be tokenization + a small generation bias where unit/paren tokens got merged or reordered. Do you have token dumps?

samir: Tokenized diffs: 
```
tokenized(fp16): ["Adjustment", ":", " ", "(", "$", "1", ",", "234", ".", "56", ")"]
tokenized(int4): ["Adjustment", ":", " ", "(", "$", "1234.56", ")"]
```

priya: The comma is being folded into the numeric token which probably changes the next-token probabilities — model prefers to move the sign out. Two quick mitigations: 1) add the two failing prompts to the Caspian blocking set; 2) route queries matching negative-money-regex to fp16 temporarily; 3) try a pre-tokenization hook that forces split on digit-comma-digit and preserves parentheses-space tokens.

infra-bot: CI job queued: quickpack/4101112222-repro matrix=[fp16,awq-4bit,gptq-4bit] job=778899

alexa: I'll prototype a packaging patch that inserts a zero-width splitter between digit and comma but also ensures '(' and ')' stay separate tokens when adjacent to numbers. If quick local patch passes we can gate it by client header.

samir: Repro command used: 
```
./ci/run_quickpack.sh --client caspian --adapter lora/caspian-v0.6 --base cascade-base-3b --quant awq-4bit --prompts tests/caspian_negative_money.jsonl
```

eval-bot: quick-eval: 130 tests, 2 failures; artifacts: s3://redwood-test-results/caspian/4101112222/summary.json :warning:

priya: I ran a local build with a tiny pre-split patch that treats digit-comma-digit and preserves '(' and ')' as standalone tokens. Local quickpack: 130/130 pass.

infra-bot: PR opened: infra/quant/patches#913 author=alexa title="preserve-paren-and-split-digit-comma for caspian negative-money cases"

alexa: Will gate the patch with a feature flag (quant-tokenfix=caspian) to limit blast radius. Then schedule a canary on dedicated-canary-7.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: canary/caspian-parenfix @ 2025-05-27T05:00:00Z  target pool: dedicated-canary-7

samir: Added failing cases to tests/caspian_negative_money.jsonl and flagged them blocking. Also notifying CS to expect a short routing fallback while we validate.

eval-bot: postpatch quick-eval (job 778950) uploaded: 130/130 pass  artifacts: s3://redwood-test-results/caspian/4101112222/postpatch-summary.json :tada:

priya: Nice. After canary, run an embed-sanity check and a small rerank probe to ensure no downstream flips. Also monitor token_count histogram for significant shifts.

alexa: Agreed. I'll include those monitors in the canary runbook and keep the flag gated until we get 48h of clean telemetry.

samir: Thanks all for the quick triage — closing loop once canary completes. :thumbsup:
